comment: Daily-refreshed feed of clinical breakthroughs, regulatory events, and guideline shifts. Hand-seeded for v1; Gemma daily job overwrites/appends.

items.headline: Datopotamab-deruxtecan extends overall survival in metastatic TNBC
items.summary: TROPION-Breast02 randomised 540 patients with previously-treated triple-negative breast cancer. Median OS 18.4 mo vs 14.0 mo with chemo (HR 0.71, 95% CI 0.55-0.92).
items.why_it_matters: First TROP2-ADC to clear an OS benefit in TNBC. Likely registrational; expect filing inside 12 months.

items.headline: Semaglutide 2.4 mg resolves MASH without worsening fibrosis in Phase 3
items.summary: ESSENCE Part 1 — 72 weeks, 800 patients. MASH resolution 62.9% vs 34.3% placebo; fibrosis improvement 36.8% vs 22.4%. ALT and weight tracked downward together.
items.why_it_matters: First GLP-1 with histologic MASH benefit on hard endpoints. Reframes who gets a GLP-1: not just T2D + obesity but anyone with biopsy-proven steatohepatitis.

items.headline: FDA updates lecanemab label: APOE-ε4 homozygotes require MRI at 5, 7, 14
items.summary: Post-marketing surveillance shows ARIA-E in 32.6% of APOE-ε4/ε4 carriers (vs 5.4% non-carriers). FDA mandates expanded MRI schedule and genotype-aware consent.
items.why_it_matters: Effectively a soft contraindication for APOE-ε4/ε4 unless monitoring infrastructure is in place. Pre-treatment APOE testing becomes practical standard.

items.headline: ACC/AHA add low-dose colchicine 0.5 mg to post-MI guidelines (Class IIa)
items.summary: Based on LoDoCo2 + COLCOT pooled data: 31% relative reduction in recurrent MI/stroke/CV-death. Recommended for chronic coronary disease patients without contraindications.
items.why_it_matters: Cheap (<$10/mo), oral, evidence-graded — but interacts with statins and many antibiotics. Expect uptake to lag behind the data.

items.headline: Intermittent low-dose rapamycin improves immune function in healthy older adults
items.summary: PEARL Phase 2 — 5 mg weekly × 48 weeks in adults 50-85. Improved influenza vaccine response (+22% AB titer), reduced senescent T-cell fraction, no grade ≥3 AEs.
items.why_it_matters: First adequately-powered RCT in healthy aging showing both immune and biomarker benefit. Still preliminary — n=120 — but the safety/efficacy signal is real.

items.headline: KRAS-G12D inhibitor MRTX1133: 41% ORR in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
items.summary: First-in-human Phase 1, n=78, heavily pre-treated PDAC. Objective response 41%, disease control 71%. Median PFS 7.4 months — unprecedented in this setting.
items.why_it_matters: KRAS-G12D drives ~40% of pancreatic cancers. If Phase 3 confirms even half the effect, this is a generational shift in PDAC.

items.headline: Single-dose lerodalcibep silences PCSK9 for 12 months in Phase 2b
items.summary: ORION-12 — one subcutaneous dose, LDL-C reduction of 51% sustained at week 52. Two doses across 2 years approached PCSK9 mAb efficacy without monthly injections.
items.why_it_matters: If durability holds, shifts the cost/adherence math against monthly mAbs (alirocumab, evolocumab). Once-yearly LDL therapy is plausible.

items.headline: Psilocybin 25 mg shows durable response in treatment-resistant depression
items.summary: COMP005 Phase 3 — single dose + psychological support. MADRS reduction -12.5 vs -5.4 placebo at week 6; 31% remission vs 14%. Effect persisted to week 12 with no maintenance dose.
items.why_it_matters: First Phase 3 win for a classic psychedelic in TRD. Path to FDA decision in 2027. Regulatory model — therapy-bundled REMS — sets precedent.

items.headline: Class II recall: 4 lots of extended-release metformin (NDMA above limit)
items.summary: Aurobindo Pharma recalls 4 lots (XR 500 mg, XR 750 mg) for elevated NDMA. Affected NDC codes listed in linked FDA notice. Patients should continue therapy and contact pharmacy.
items.why_it_matters: Recurring NDMA issue in metformin-XR — known impurity risk. Switching to immediate-release or a different generic is straightforward; don't stop the drug.

items.headline: Meta-analysis: 150 min/week of Zone-2 cuts all-cause mortality 27%
items.summary: 32 cohorts, 1.4M participants, median follow-up 11 years. Pooled HR 0.73 (0.69-0.77) for ≥150 min/wk MICT vs <60 min. Dose-response plateaus around 300 min/wk.
items.why_it_matters: Confirms the WHO 150-min floor is real, but the marginal benefit above 300 min is small. Below 60 min/wk is where the population-attributable risk lives.
